cohort: The study included 150 healthy infants in Saudi Arabia, whose mothers had previously decided to exclusively or partially formula feed, enrolled within 24 hours after birth.
finding: The ready-to-feed formula was very well accepted and well tolerated among healthy newborns in Saudi Arabia during the immediate postnatal period, with generally low GI symptoms and discomfort scores.
followup_time: until hospital discharge in the immediate postnatal period
